name: Detektiv -- igra na logiku
source:
The player is invited to conduct an investigation into the terrible murder in the tavern.

"Today you will have to be in the role of a detective, who in the future may become great and illustrious

However, Rome was not built right away, and even great detectives once had a first case. Therefore, while you - new to the detective business.

Dear reader is invited to conduct this investigation with the detective. And let the investigation begin! "

[From Google Play]
